subject: Vendor onboarding + PO requirements for Greenfield Health
messages:
From: Jane Ellis <jane.ellis@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>, AP Team <ap@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor registration request — Redwood Inference

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement asked me to kick off vendor onboarding so we can get POs in place and process Redwood as a supplier.

Could you please:
- Complete the attached VendorForm_GFH.pdf and return it signed.
- Upload your W9 (or tax certificate if non-US) and bank/ACH instructions into our vendor portal at the link below.
- Confirm the legal entity name and remit address we should use for PO/invoice matching.

A couple of important AP requirements:
- Every invoice must include the GFH PO number in the "PO#" field and on the invoice PDF filename.
- Submit invoices to ap@greenfieldhealth.com as a single PDF; we also accept CSV line-item extracts for high-volume invoices.
- Standard payment term: Net 45 from invoice date (exceptions require approval).

I've attached the vendor form and a short checklist. Let me know if you need a different remittance address or a W-8/W-9 clarification.

Thanks,
Jane Ellis
Senior Sourcing Manager
Greenfield Health

Attachments: VendorForm_GFH.pdf, Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Jane Ellis <jane.ellis@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-06T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration request — Redwood Inference

Jane —

Appreciate the note and the clear checklist. We've started internal coordination. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address: 1201 Market St, Suite 150, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Tax ID (EIN): 27-3489152 (W-9 attached).

I've attached our completed onboarding packet (Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.pdf) and an unsigned W9 stub for now; we'll send the signed W9 by end of day. For banking info we prefer to use ACH — we will upload via the secure one-time link below rather than emailing banking details.

Question: do your POs require an itemized SKU-level breakdown or will a single line describing the product (e.g., "Redwood Inference — Hosted API usage for Oct 2025") be sufficient? We often bill consolidated monthly usage.

Looping in Laura (billing lead) and Neha (legal) to keep them in the loop for any contract fields.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet.pdf, Redwood_W9_2025.pdf
Secure upload link (banking): https://secure-upload.redwood.ai/txn/9482

From: Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Jane Ellis <jane.ellis@greenfieldhealth.com>, AP Team <ap@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-07T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration request — Redwood Inference

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the W9. A few clarifications from AP/Procurement:
- PO requirements: every invoice must have the GFH PO number in the Invoice header and in the filename (example: GFH-12345_Redwood_Invoice_20251101.pdf).
- Invoice content: PO#, invoice date, total, and per-line description (quantity, unit price) preferred. If you submit consolidated monthly invoices, include a CSV with line items attached.
- Payment terms are Net 45; we can consider Net 30 for contracts > $100k with procurement approval.
- Banking: please complete bank account verification via our portal (https://portal.greenfieldhealth.com/vendor-setup/submit). We cannot accept ACH details by plain email.
- Tax docs: W-9 received; no additional tax docs needed for US entity.

I'll place a note to expedite vendor activation once we receive the signed VendorForm_GFH.pdf and bank verification.

Procurement has created a temporary vendor record — please expect a DocuSign to sign the vendor form if you prefer e-signature.

Regards,
GFH Procurement Team

Attachment: VendorForm_GFH.pdf (pending signature)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-10T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration request — Redwood Inference

Team — quick notes from Finance before we finalize uploads:
- Do NOT include full bank account numbers in the packet sent to procurement; use the secure portal only. We will upload masked account information and provide verification screenshots where required.
- Invoice formatting: Finance asks that the invoice header include our legal entity and address exactly as provided above to prevent matching delays. Please make the invoice description consistent: "Redwood Inference - Hosted API Usage - [YYYY-MM]". This helps automated PO/invoice matching on GFH side.
- For POs that reference multiple invoice lines, include a subtotal per line and an overall total; where possible include the originating HubSpot deal id in the invoice notes (if a PO maps to a specific purchase).

Laura — would you be the primary billing contact for incoming questions from GFH AP? If so, I'll add you to our billing workflow and to the HubSpot account.

Neha — FYI on the procurement terms above; if they request an exception to Net45 we'll need approval level noted.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: AP Team <ap@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Jane Ellis <jane.ellis@greenfieldhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-12T15:28:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor activation complete — GFH vendor ID GFH-98742

Hi Monica and Laura,

Vendor onboarding is complete. Vendor ID: GFH-98742.
Next steps:
- We will issue the first PO (GFH-12345) by 2025-11-18; please ensure the invoice references GFH-12345.
- Invoices should be submitted to ap@greenfieldhealth.com as a single PDF. For consolidated monthly invoices, include the CSV per our checklist.
- We have the W-9 on file and a verified bank record from the portal.

Attached is the confirmation PDF for your records. If you need the vendor record exported from our system (for tax reporting or audit), reply and we'll provide it via secure link.

Regards,
GFH Accounts Payable
AP Team

Attachment: Vendor_Registration_Confirmation_GFH-98742.pdf
